DESCRIPTION: Shared base rule (every owner). Any account whose handle is listed here is auto-blocked (layer known_scam_list), unless that owner chose ✅ keep / asked to unblock it. Add with `python3 -m fis known-list ingest`, remove with `python3 -m fis known-list remove --handle h --reason "..."`. Entries: handle (lowercase), display_name, reason, source, added, evidence (first 200 characters of the bio when listed).
